techniques.name: Active Scanning
techniques.description: Adversaries probe victim infrastructure through network traffic before compromise.

techniques.name: Acquire Infrastructure
techniques.description: Adversaries buy, lease, or rent infrastructure to stage an operation.

techniques.name: Phishing
techniques.description: Adversaries send fraudulent messages to gain access or execute code.

techniques.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
techniques.description: Adversaries exploit a weakness in an Internet-facing application to gain entry.

techniques.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
techniques.description: Adversaries abuse command and script interpreters to execute code.

techniques.name: PowerShell
techniques.description: Adversaries abuse PowerShell for execution of commands and scripts.

techniques.name: Windows Command Shell
techniques.description: Adversaries abuse cmd.exe to execute commands, scripts, and binaries.

techniques.name: Scheduled Task/Job
techniques.description: Adversaries schedule tasks to run code at a defined time for execution or persistence.

techniques.name: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution
techniques.description: Adversaries configure system settings to run code automatically at boot or logon.

techniques.name: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism
techniques.description: Adversaries bypass elevation controls to obtain higher privileges.

techniques.name: Obfuscated Files or Information
techniques.description: Adversaries encode or encrypt files and payloads to hinder detection.

techniques.name: Valid Accounts
techniques.description: Adversaries use legitimate credentials to blend in and maintain access.

techniques.name: Brute Force
techniques.description: Adversaries guess or crack credentials through repeated attempts.

techniques.name: OS Credential Dumping
techniques.description: Adversaries extract account credentials from the operating system.

techniques.name: File and Directory Discovery
techniques.description: Adversaries enumerate files and directories to orient themselves.

techniques.name: Process Discovery
techniques.description: Adversaries list running processes to understand the environment.

techniques.name: Remote Services
techniques.description: Adversaries use valid accounts over remote services to move laterally.

techniques.name: Remote Desktop Protocol
techniques.description: Adversaries use RDP to log into and control remote hosts.

techniques.name: Data from Local System
techniques.description: Adversaries collect data from the local host before exfiltration.

techniques.name: Application Layer Protocol
techniques.description: Adversaries tunnel command and control over standard application protocols.

techniques.name: Web Protocols
techniques.description: Adversaries use HTTP/S traffic to blend command and control with web browsing.

techniques.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
techniques.description: Adversaries steal data over the existing command and control channel.

techniques.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
techniques.description: Adversaries encrypt data to disrupt availability, as in ransomware.

techniques.name: Inhibit System Recovery
techniques.description: Adversaries delete or disable recovery features to hinder restoration.

techniques.name: Scripting
techniques.description: Deprecated technique, merged into Command and Scripting Interpreter (T1059).
